daily.today_energy: Your emotional intelligence is *chef's kiss* today. The moon's got your back, encouraging you to trust those gut feelings that have been whispering lately. Lean into your intuition—it knows something you haven't figured out yet.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, today's about authentic connection. If you've been holding back, consider sharing what's really on your mind. Vulnerability hits different when you're genuine about it.
daily.career: Your creativity is seriously activated right now. That project you've been overthinking? Time to stop second-guessing and start moving. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed, even if it feels unconventional.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Honor that by doing something that feels nourishing—whether that's rest, movement, or just drinking water like it's your job. Mental clarity follows when you take care of your vessel.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to soften your edges, Cancer. You're carrying old patterns like luggage—it's time to set some down. Trust that vulnerability isn't weakness; it's your superpower.
weekly.love: Someone's seeing you differently lately, and honestly, they might be onto something. If you're single, a genuine conversation is brewing. If coupled, reconnect over something that made you laugh together.
weekly.career: Your ideas have more weight than you think right now. Speak up in that meeting or share your vision with someone who matters. The energy supports bold honesty over playing it safe.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Whether that's stretching, longer showers, or just sleeping in—listen. Energy is tied to how you treat yourself, and you deserve that care.
